text.en: Clients describe the grooming team as lovely, warm, and exceptionally professional from reception through pick-up. Reviewers praise the stylists for listening carefully to owners' requests and offering clear advice on grooming maintenance. The staff's welcoming attitude and customer service create a relaxed atmosphere that pet owners genuinely appreciate.

Pet parents highlight the stylists' remarkable ability to soothe nervous and reactive dogs during baths and nail trims. Several reviewers note that dogs previously requiring heavy veterinary sedation were groomed comfortably and calmly without medication. Owners value the patient, loving environment where pets feel secure and eager to return for spa days.

title.en: High quality coats and styled cuts

text.en: Reviews consistently praise the quality of haircuts, de-shedding treatments, and nail trimming. Owners of long-haired breeds and doodles remark that their dogs look neatly trimmed, feel soft, and smell wonderful after their grooming sessions. Clients express high satisfaction with the thorough brushing, ear cleaning, and balanced finishing cuts.

q.en: Can Diva Doggies groom anxious dogs without sedation?

a.en: Yes, reviewers share that the stylists successfully handle anxious pets using calm, patient techniques without sedation.

q.en: Are nail trims available as a standalone service?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently visit the salon for quick and gentle walk-in or scheduled nail trims.

q.en: What grooming treatments are offered for thick or double coats?

a.en: The salon provides comprehensive de-shedding packages, full baths, conditioning, and breed-specific styling.

q.en: How can clients book an appointment at Diva Doggies?

a.en: Clients can reserve grooming appointments through the salon's online booking system or by contacting the team directly.
